description: This Java class defines a GUI panel for configuring connection options to a service, including host, port, user, password, and trust store path, using Swing components.

classes.name: ServerOptionsPanel
classes.description: A GUI panel for configuring server connection options with fields for host, port, user, password, and trust store path.

methods.name: ServerOptionsPanel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the panel with a title and adds labeled text fields.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the hostname entered in the panel.

methods.name: setHost
methods.description: Sets the hostname in the panel.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port entered in the panel.

methods.name: setPort
methods.description: Sets the port in the panel.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the username entered in the panel.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the username in the panel.

methods.name: getPwd
methods.description: Returns the password entered in the panel.

methods.name: setPwd
methods.description: Sets the password in the panel.

methods.name: getTrustStorePath
methods.description: Returns the trust store path entered in the panel.

methods.name: setTrustStorePath
methods.description: Sets the trust store path in the panel.

methods.name: clearGui
methods.description: Clears all input fields in the GUI panel.
